what: 226 tiles spread evenly through the region bake's L5-L7 tiles in node order (layer 085efb54), decoded in the decode workers and uploaded through the upload queue into surface pools of 256 slots (L0-L1 fixed at 0-29) at the full animated budget, one queue run per frame with nothing drawn between, by e2e/lab/surface-upload.lab.ts. Times are each write call on the main thread, at the browser's performance.now() resolution (0.1 ms in Chromium, 1 ms in Safari and Firefox). Every slot read back exactly and no GL error was raised.
renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5, Unspecified Version)
